_description: Branch-level individual scorecards for retail branch staff. Covers Customer Service Officers (service role) and 5 branch sales roles (BB / PB / BRM / BSRO / DSR). For sales roles, the producer submits non-pipeline KPIs (CX, audit, compliance, productivity, new customers); pipeline_to_bsc supplies the sales/pipeline KPIs through its enhanced activity bridge. The two paths interlock — neither role gets a complete scorecard from either alone.
_design_principles: Pipeline is the canonical source for sales KPIs (DISB_*, NFI, PIPELINE_*)
Branch staff generator owns operational / service / behavioural KPIs
Customer Service Officers: full service scorecard from this generator
Branch sales roles: service + operational KPIs here, pipeline-fed sales KPIs elsewhere

CUSTOMER_SERVICE.name: Customer Service
CUSTOMER_SERVICE._note: Branch counter service — onboarding, account ops, complaint handling. Full scorecard from this generator (no pipeline activity expected).

BRANCH_SALES.name: Branch Sales
BRANCH_SALES.scope_filter: role in [BB / PB / BRM / BSRO / DSR]
BRANCH_SALES._note: Sales-active branch roles. This generator covers non-pipeline KPIs (CX/audit/compliance/staff productivity/new customers). Pipeline-fed sales KPIs (DISB_*, NFI, PIPELINE_*) arrive via pipeline_to_bsc's activity bridge.

_rationale.split_with_pipeline: Sales staff have a split scorecard by design: pipeline owns the canonical sales KPIs (won deals → DISB_*, Total NFI). This generator covers what pipeline doesn't — operational quality, customer experience, compliance discipline. The same role can get inputs from both producers because the BSC engine indexes on (staff_code, kpi_id) without collision when KPIs differ.
_rationale.csos_full_coverage: CSOs have no pipeline footprint by role definition. They get a full scorecard from this generator alone.
_rationale.no_disbursement_values_for_sales: This generator deliberately does NOT submit DISB_RETAIL / DISB_MSME / Total NFI for sales staff — pipeline_to_bsc owns those. Submitting both would cause last-write-wins ambiguity. Each producer has a clearly-defined slice of the KPI vocabulary.
